title: Google's Major Benefit: Gemini Daily Briefing Feature Now Fully Open to All Free Users

content_html:
Google has officially announced that the "Daily Briefing" feature of its AI assistant Gemini is now fully available to all free subscribers. Previously, this useful feature was set as a paid requirement, available only to advanced subscribers of Google AI Plus, Pro, or Ultra.

As a convenient smart assistant function, Gemini Daily Briefing can generate a highly condensed summary for users every morning. It helps users quickly organize their daily tasks, review unread emails, and present other important key information, significantly improving the efficiency of morning information processing.

In terms of terminal compatibility and coverage, this feature is now supported on both web and mobile app clients. Users can easily access clear and readable information summaries through Gemini. Currently, the feature is available to free users in the United States first, and Google plans to gradually expand it to more countries and regions around the world, covering a broader user base.

In addition, Google has also announced new developments in product experience optimization. In the future, the official plan is to add an audio playback option for the Gemini Daily Briefing. Through this potential upgrade, users will not only be able to read text but also receive the daily briefing like listening to a podcast, further enriching the scenarios and interaction experiences for daily information access.
